gaps.missing: nothing anymore — the old premise is void under D018-2. The 163 AECC_PARCEL records of Survey-3 are 163 SITE records and no parcels: the application casts every one to Autodesk.Civil.DatabaseServices.Site (names 'Survey Site' + 162 GUID names, in record order, matching the record names exactly), each with GetParcelIds()==0; there is not a single Parcel object in the drawing. The discriminator was already in main: parcel_site() is None for a site record, Some(site) for a parcel record (Survey-3: 0/163 carry a site reference; Parcel-2C: 11/12 do). The 'parcel outlines' the old analyze reconstructed from the site records' proxy graphics are artifacts — 78 identical 5x0.4 origin boxes plus 85 figure-corner rectangles. Of those, 61 properly CROSS survey figures (segment-vs-segment against all 85 figure BaseCurves, captured live), which no true parcel outline may (D018-2). The old writer refusals ('the line crosses or touches a member it may not meet', 129 of 163) were the application-faithful answer to injecting 163 overlapping junk rectangles into one site — not a capability ask
gaps.implementable: done — analyze splits AECC_PARCEL by the site reference: parcel family (site ref present, outline from the proxy graphic, site name resolved) + site family (name + desc, no outline); build writes the site family through add_site and joins each parcel to its named site
gaps.evidence: L1 on the fixed tree: survey_3 built -> re-analyzed site 163 items BIT-EXACT, cogo_point 538 BIT-EXACT, built census {AECC_COGO_POINT:538, AeccDbFace:163} == oracle census 163 (was 35 faces). App cross-check: 163 Site entities, 0 Parcels, 0 parcels per site (cap.figsite.types.txt, cap.figsite.site_names.txt); figures 85 with full BaseCurve geometry (cap.figsite.figures.txt)
